import Spec
import I5hLib
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result oxicloud_kernel oxicloud_kernel.Spec I5hLib

namespace oxicloud_kernel.Solution

theorem require_ok (db : model.Db) (env : grantapi.Env) (s : model.Subject)
    (p : model.Permission) (r : model.Resource) (u : Unit)
    (h : grantapi.require db env s p r = ok (core.result.Result.Ok u)) :
    acl.check db env.migration_readonly env.now s p r = ok true := by
  unfold grantapi.require at h
  rw [bind_tc_eq_ok] at h
  obtain ⟨b, hcheck, hrest⟩ := h
  cases b with
  | true => exact hcheck
  | false =>
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at hrest
    i5h_invert hrest

theorem create_needs_share (db db' : model.Db) (env : grantapi.Env) (caller : U64) (r : model.Resource)
    (s : model.Subject) (role : model.Role) (e : Option I64) (rep : grantapi.Reply)
    (h : grantapi.transition db env caller (.CreateGrant r s role e) = ok (db', .Ok rep)) :
    acl.check db env.migration_readonly env.now (.User caller) .Share r = ok true := by
  unfold grantapi.transition grantapi.create_grant at h
  rw [bind_tc_eq_ok] at h
  obtain ⟨r1, hreq, hrest⟩ := h
  cases r1 with
  | Ok u => exact require_ok db env (.User caller) .Share r u hreq
  | Err err => i5h_invert hrest

end oxicloud_kernel.Solution
